verdict.rationale: Postman docs explicitly reference an 'Environments' feature alongside Variables, and community evidence confirms teams use Postman to test/validate APIs 'across environments,' supporting the dev/staging/prod switching workflow via environment variable sets. However, the evidence pack lacks a detailed first-party doc excerpt walking through creating multiple environments and switching between them. Missing for 10: a direct doc excerpt describing environment creation/switching UI, and independent hands-on confirmation of variable-set switching specifically.
